study_title: Professional-Network Proximity Bias in Peer Review
phenomenon_name_rule: The review-score effect is called 'professional-network proximity bias in peer review'. 'Preferential attachment' refers only to the source-simulation network-formation mechanism, never to the review-score effect.

scientific_questions.H1_primary: Revealing a two-hop collaboration-network relationship increases review scores relative to revealing identity+institution alone, more than revealing a far/no relationship does. Direction: mean paper_effect > 0.
scientific_questions.H2_secondary: The relationship-disclosure effect is smaller at distance 3 than at distance 2 (monotone trend d2 > d3 > far).
scientific_questions.H3_secondary: The effect is absent or smallest for far or disconnected reviewer-author pairs.
scientific_questions.H4_secondary: Author and reviewer betweenness centrality moderate the relationship-disclosure effect.

design_summary: Paired within reviewer-paper-pair replay. Each matched paper has three expertise-matched reviewers at exact network distance 2, exact distance 3, and a frozen far comparator. Each reviewer-paper pair is evaluated under three information conditions: A (double-blind), B (identity+institution, relationship field 'undisclosed'), C (identity+institution + accurate frozen relationship sentence). Treatment is the content of the relationship field; B and C are byte-identical elsewhere. Primary contrast is paper-level: (C-B at d2) - (C-B at far).

graph_timing_rule.snapshot: For a review in source year y, network distance and all node metrics use G_{y-1}: only edges with min(edge.years) <= y-1. Future or same-year edges never enter.
graph_timing_rule.assertion: extract asserts zero edges with min(years) >= y in any snapshot used for year y; violation count reported in structural_audit.json (must be 0)

focal_author_rule.definition: The focal author is the first/corresponding author recorded by the source simulator: paper['author_id'] if scalar, else paper['author_id'][0].
focal_author_rule.distance: Distance strata are reviewer-to-focal-author distances in G_{y-1}.
focal_author_rule.disclosure: Conditions B and C disclose only the focal author's synthetic identifier and institution. Co-author identities never appear in replay prompts.

eligibility_and_coi.paper_eligibility: focal author present in G_{y-1} with >=1 pre-review edge; complete title/abstract/topics; review year known; source integrity checks passed
reviewer_exclusions_screened_against_ALL: is any author of the paper
is a distance-1 collaborator of ANY author in G_{y-1}
has a recorded conflict_of_interest with ANY author
belongs to the same institution as ANY author
eligibility_and_coi.reviewer_requirements: active agent with can_review and non-empty expertise
eligibility_and_coi.distance_1_note: Direct collaborators are excluded from the primary experiment as COI. A d1 condition may appear only as a separately labeled exploratory stress test outside the primary hypothesis family, and only if budget permits after the main experiment.

distance_strata.d2: exact shortest-path distance 2 to focal author in G_{y-1}
distance_strata.disconnected: no path (different components, or reviewer absent from graph)

far_comparator_rule.condition: connected d>=4 is the primary far comparator ONLY IF at least the full final sample target (the configured target of 300, 240, or 200) complete matched papers can be constructed with one d2, one d3, and one connected-d>=4 reviewer under all expertise/COI/timing/reuse constraints
far_comparator_rule.fallback: otherwise the pooled far-or-disconnected comparator is primary
far_comparator_rule.decision_timing: made at the structural gate from graph availability only, before any replay response is generated; decision and supporting counts recorded in structural_audit.json
far_comparator_rule.secondary_reporting: connected-far and disconnected effects always reported separately in secondary analyses

expertise_matching.embedding_model: sentence-transformers all-MiniLM-L6-v2, snapshot 1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41, via utopia.metrics.embedding_tracker.EmbeddingTracker sha256-keyed cache
expertise_matching.reviewer_text: ', '.join(sorted(expertise topic strings)) (fixed agent expertise; static over the run — verified; if any representation were history-derived it would be filtered to < review year)
expertise_matching.tolerance: max pairwise similarity gap within a (d2,d3,far) triplet <= 0.10
expertise_matching.exclusion_rule: papers with no feasible triplet under all constraints are excluded and funnel-logged
expertise_matching.balance_reporting: per-stratum similarity means, SDs, standardized differences reported in structural_audit.json and report

matching_algorithm.type: deterministic bounded greedy, two passes, no iterative re-optimization toward a sample-size target
matching_algorithm.paper_processing_order: sort candidate papers by increasing number of feasible triplets, then by stable lexicographic paper ID
triplet_objective_in_order: 2. minimize sum of current reviewer-use counts
matching_algorithm.reuse_cap_fallback: 15, permitted only if the cap of 10 prevents reaching 200 matched papers; must be decided before any review responses are generated and never changed afterwards
matching_algorithm.revisiting: assignments are never revisited; the cap is never exceeded
matching_algorithm.second_pass: exactly one deterministic second pass over papers left unmatched by the first pass, same objective
matching_algorithm.determinism_test: unit test: input-order permutations of papers and candidate lists produce the identical matched corpus

samples.smoke_selection: deterministic stratified selection of 24 papers from the matched corpus using derive_seed(42,'nrb','smoke_select'); disjoint from main by construction (removed before main sampling)
samples.main_target_ladder: 300 if >=300 complete matched triplets remain after smoke removal; else 240 if >=240; else 200 if >=200; else stop with insufficient structural support
samples.main_sampling: stratify as far as feasible across source seed, source year, original source-review acceptance outcome, paper novelty bucket, and focal-author degree bucket; deterministic proportional largest-remainder allocation; stable tie-breaks by paper ID; eligible and selected counts per cell recorded; inclusion probabilities recorded for population-level descriptive analyses
samples.stability_selection: frozen stratified rule over the same sampling cells applied to the SELECTED main sample using derive_seed(42,'nrb','stability_select'); never the first 60
samples.no_outcome_dependence: no sampling step may read replay scores or effects

conditions.A_blind: no author-information block; title/abstract/topics + reviewer expertise + frozen balanced policy + standard rubric only

C_relationship.d2: You and this author are connected through one intermediary collaborator in the current collaboration network.
C_relationship.d3: You and this author are connected by a collaboration-network path of length three.
C_relationship.far_connected: You and this author have no collaboration-network path shorter than four steps in the current graph.
C_relationship.disconnected: You and this author are in disconnected components of the current collaboration graph.

conditions.synthetic_id: Researcher {sha256(focal_author_id.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]} — stable across conditions and panels
conditions.institution: focal author's university_name from the source ecosystem
conditions.b_c_invariant: B and C prompts byte-identical outside relationship_value (extract-time assertion + unit test)

reviewer_policy_and_memory.policy_text: You apply the conference's standard review policy: weigh methodological soundness, novelty, clarity, significance, and feasibility evenly. Base your score only on the paper's content as presented, applying the scoring rubric consistently and impartially.
reviewer_policy_and_memory.memory: empty memory_bank in all conditions and strata

task_identity_and_generation.task_uid: paper_id|reviewer_id|condition|distance_stratum|panel_id with panel_id in {primary, stability}; uniqueness and main/stability disjointness asserted
task_identity_and_generation.grid: 3 conditions x 3 strata = 9 calls per paper per panel

call_budget.plus: failed-record retries only; no additional full global seeds

task_identity_and_generation.condition_order_randomization: per paper-reviewer triplet, the A/B/C execution order is one of the 6 permutations chosen by derive_seed(42,'nrb','order',paper_id,reviewer_id) mod 6; approximately balanced across the corpus; stored as condition_order; execution sort key preserves it exactly on resume; order is a non-primary sensitivity covariate and never changes condition labels
task_identity_and_generation.request_seed_policy: NO common-random-number claim across A/B/C (vLLM client derives per-request seeds from batch position). Complete task file, ordering, chunk size (512), and chunk boundaries frozen before generation with sha256 in the corpus manifest. Resume skips only fully-completed task UIDs and never compacts partial chunks. attempt-0 request seed recorded per task; retry/tail-sweep seeds distinct and labeled. Post-prereg chunk-size change is rejected with an explicit error.
task_identity_and_generation.stability_seeds: fresh request seeds via distinct seed_ctx ('nrb', corpus_version, 'stability', chunk_index)

primary_endpoint.unit: paper (matched triplet); the reviewer-paper pair is the unit for the within-pair C-B difference
primary_endpoint.definition: delta_i_s = score_C_i_s - score_B_i_s for s in {d2, d3, far}; paper_effect_i = delta_i_d2 - delta_i_far; primary estimand = mean_i(paper_effect_i)
primary_endpoint.inclusion: only papers with complete valid B and C responses for BOTH the d2 reviewer and the frozen far-comparator reviewer enter the primary analysis; completeness funnel reported
primary_endpoint.score: raw numeric overall_score primary; simulator-style int-cast score preregistered sensitivity
primary_endpoint.inference: paper-level nonparametric bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed derive_seed(42,'nrb','boot_primary'); 95% percentile CI; two-sided p via CI inversion
robustness_required: reviewer-pair-level stacked regression (delta ~ stratum indicators, cluster-robust)
primary_endpoint.minimal_scientifically_interesting_effec: 0.10 raw score points (1-5 scale) for the primary contrast; effects below this with CI excluding 0.10 are labeled 'statistically detectable but below the minimal interesting magnitude'

secondary_family_bh_corrected: S2 ordinal distance trend of delta across {2,3,far} (weighted least squares slope, paper-clustered bootstrap)
S3 connected-far vs disconnected relationship effect
S4 identity-only effect: mean(score_B - score_A) pooled and by stratum
S5 author-betweenness moderation: paper_effect_i ~ standardized focal-author betweenness (paper-clustered bootstrap)
S6 reviewer-betweenness moderation: delta_j ~ standardized reviewer betweenness (stacked, two-way clustered)
S7 acceptance-decision sensitivity: flip rate of deterministic acceptance rule between B and C by stratum
S8 stability replication: primary contrast in the 60-paper stability panel, agreement with main
multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg at q=0.05 within the 8-member secondary family; primary tested alone at alpha=0.05
descriptive_non_blocking: relationship-mention rate in C justifications (frozen keyword list: ['collaborat', 'connect', 'network', 'relationship', 'mutual', 'intermediary', 'co-author', 'coauthor', 'path', 'component'])

rationale positivity via frozen word lists (positive: ['strong','novel','clear','significant','sound','compelling','thorough','promising','rigorous','excellent']; negative: ['weak','unclear','incremental','flawed','limited','insufficient','vague','unconvincing','marginal','poor'])
network topology (path length, clustering, degree distribution, components, betweenness distribution) — context only, never evidence of review bias
sensitivities_not_in_bh_family: IPW to the eligible-paper population using recorded inclusion probabilities (descriptive)

missingness_rules.parse_failure: one in-request retry cycle (client max_retries=3) then one tail-sweep pass with distinct labeled seeds; rows failing after sweep are missing
missingness_rules.primary: listwise by paper for the primary (complete-triplet requirement on d2 and far B/C cells)
missingness_rules.secondary: each secondary uses papers complete for the cells it needs; per-analysis Ns reported
missingness_rules.threshold: if >2% of primary cells are missing after sweep, report as a limitation and run a worst-case bounds sensitivity

leakage_and_integrity.scanner: section-aware scan_leakage: legitimate paper section may contain title/abstract/topics; A must contain no synthetic id, institution, or relationship sentence; B must contain identity+institution but no relationship sentence other than the frozen 'undisclosed' placeholder; C may contain exactly the frozen relationship block
leakage_and_integrity.memory: current paper absent from reviewer memory by construction (empty memory)
leakage_and_integrity.source_integrity: source checkpoints and ledgers must pass existing integrity checks before extraction

structural_gate_criteria.timing: after source generation and matching, before any replay generation
must_report: reviewer-reuse distribution, max, effective number of reviewers, reuse by stratum
proceed_only_if: zero direct collaborator or COI in primary set

smoke_gate_13_criteria: no d1 COI in primary tasks
B/C differ only in relationship field
resume does not repeat completed UIDs
conclusion_labels: inconclusive due to matching or precision
invalid due to failed design checks
no_tuning_rule: distance definitions, matching thresholds, comparator rules, and samples are never tuned to obtain significance; nulls are reported as results, not failures
